title: Magic Gel Horse Ice Pack with Carry Case - Single Ice Boots | Cooling Horse Leg Wraps for Hock, Ankle, Knee, Legs, Boots, and Hooves | Horse Tack & Horse Supplies & Ideal Gift for Horse Lovers Women
features: EASE DISCOMFORT - Our ice packs are designed to help provide relief for soft tissue-related unwellness in hardworking horses. They can be used to promote comfort during their downtime
ONE SIZE FITS ALL - This is a large ice pack, covering 40cm (16 inches) of one leg. Strong fastening strap closure attaches around the leg keeping it secure with adequate compression.
IDEAL USE FOR PULLED MUSCLES - These wraps can provide soothing support and serve as an alternative to cold hosing.

EASY TO APPLY - Place into a freezer (in the bag provided) cooler until frozen; Remove and secure around the leg that needs attention using the elastic fasteners; When frozen the pack will stay flexible and soft to conform around the leg/joint. Some horses may require a small layer of fabric between the ice pack and the skin.

ROBUST, DURABLE, LONG LASTING - The outer material is a thick synthetic blend that can withstand the rough treatment without breaking, leaking or damaging. You can expect at least 3 years of use from each set.
